primary.scope_limit: This design and its frozen horizon only; other overnight designs require separate multiplicity accounting.

missing_measurement_sensitivity.definition: All assignments lacking a valid reader pair, including failed generation, may be 0 or 1 adversarially by arm. These identification bounds are descriptive, not confidence intervals.

semantic.interpretation: Exploratory discovery-only same-prefix causal comparison with arm-blind LLM outcomes. All assigned errors/caps/closures/invalid ratings retained. No independent confirmation, human validation, original-prompt accuracy, token-saving utility, equivalence or optimal-trajectory claim.

dense.limitations: LLM class audit may misclassify classes. Invalid/incomplete sentence labels break adjacency; no sparse gaps are joined. Counts are observed-window descriptors; independent semantic effects remain in their separate blinded reader analysis. No gate weights are inferred from expert IDs.

inference.method: Paired family-cluster Bonferroni percentile bootstrap approximation; bounds envelope when missing.
inference.weighting: Seeds averaged within prefix; prefixes within family; equal family weight.
inference.scope: One separately corrected secondary family in this stage; no cross-stage pooled claim.
